changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS locations ( id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, user_id BIGINT NOT NULL, latitude NUMERIC(10,8) NOT NULL, longitude NUMERIC(11,8) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT fk_locations_user FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE );
